name: Our Beach House - Castlerock
parking: Free private parking for up to three cars
beachAccess: About a one-minute walk to Castlerock beach
confirmedFeatures: Two living rooms, 2.5 bathrooms, private patio, garden, barbecue
overview: A three-bedroom self-catering house about a minute's walk from Castlerock beach, with two living rooms, two and a half bathrooms, a patio, a lawn and a barbecue. There is free private parking for three cars. Castlerock Golf Club is about five minutes' walk away, and the listing names surfers among the guests it suits.
surfTripFit: Only a minute from the sand, with parking for several cars, it suits a small group surfing Castlerock and nearby Downhill.
